content.text:
In `requestCredential()` in `OID4VCIssuerEndpoint.java`, I moved the `getAuthResult()` bearer-token check ahead of `validateRequestEncryption()`. An unauthenticated request is now rejected with the invalid-token error before any realm private-key lookup, JWE decryption, DEFLATE inflation or JSON deserialization happens. I did not compile the change or run any tests, and I did not use the AxiomEngine graph because this repo has no index.

The event setup after authentication is unchanged. One behavior difference is that a request with no token and a malformed or wrongly encrypted body now gets the invalid-token error instead of an encryption error.
